Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.generator.api

package eu.cloudhopper.mc.generator.api
Defines shared types used to configure and support deployment config generators.

This package includes common models and enums that describe generator capabilities, phases, templates, and configuration metadata.

  • ConfigGenerationException
  • GenerationPhase
  • HandlerInfo
These types are used both by the Cloudhopper annotation processor and by custom generator implementations.
